title: Migrate local inference from Qwen 3.5 35B to Gemma 4 31B (8-bit)
description: Swap Daud's local inference model from mlx-community/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-8bit to mlx-community/gemma-4-31b-it-8bit — the highest-parameter model in the mlx-community Gemma 4 collection (https://huggingface.co/collections/mlx-community/gemma-4). Gemma 4 31B is multimodal (image-text-to-text) so Daud's vision tools (read_image, ixdar_screenshot, visual_quality) continue working. BLOCKED BY: VOYAGE-34 (model_protocol extraction, which adds the Gemma tool-call parser) and VOYAGE-36 (MLX_MODEL centralization, which makes this a one-line change). Tradeoff: Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B is MoE (~3B active params/token), Gemma 4 31B is dense — expect meaningfully slower tokens/sec on the same Mac. Quality on instruction-following and vision should improve. Rollback is a one-line revert in const.py + re-running server-setup.
definition-of-done: 1. src/daud/const.py MLX_MODEL = 'mlx-community/gemma-4-31b-it-8bit'. 2. README.md default-model reference updated. 3. CLAUDE.md 'Local inference (macOS)' paragraph, 'Daud' build section, and 'Daud Agent Architecture' bullet all reference Gemma 4 instead of Qwen 3.5; the 'not a vision model' caveat is rewritten since Gemma 4 IS a vision model. 4. uv run server-setup regenerates the LaunchAgent plist and restarts mlx_vlm.server with the new model. 5. curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/models returns the Gemma model. 6. End-to-end smoke tests pass (see testing plan).
testing-plan: 1. Text: uv run daud completes a trivial chat turn. 2. Tool-call: from the agent, invoke list_dir or obj_summary; confirm tool actually executes. If delta.tool_calls is empty and the Gemma fallback parser fires, verify from logs it produced valid OpenAI-shape calls. 3. Multimodal: invoke read_image on any PNG; model describes image content. 4. Ixdar render: with Ixdar running, invoke ixdar_screenshot; model responds to the render. 5. Voyage smoke: uv run daud-worker processes one queued ticket without errors. 6. Performance baseline: note tokens/sec on a standard prompt vs prior Qwen numbers. If unacceptable, consider gemma-4-31b-it-6bit (separate ticket). 7. Rollback rehearsal: flip MLX_MODEL back to Qwen string, uv run server-setup, verify normal operation returns.
